name: Private Inbox
source: Private Inbox is an erotic chat-based game where you play as Alex, a university teacher exploring his deepest desires through private DMs. Engage in steamy conversations with multiple characters, each with unique personalities and fetishes. Your choices shape the relationships, leading to thrilling, dominant, or passionate encounters.
